title: Lower and Upper Expected Hitting Times for Weighted Imprecise Markov Chains
summary: In this paper, we extend hitting times for imprecise Markov chains to the framework of weighted imprecise Markov chains (WIMCs), in which each transition is associated with a strictly positive weight encoded by a matrix $W$. Given a convex set $\mathcal{T}$ of admissible transition matrices, we define lower and upper expected hitting times for WIMCs as the infimum and supremum of the (weighted) expected hitting times over $\mathcal{T}$, and we characterise these quantities as the unique solutions of nonlinear fixed-point equations.
